picks.title: You Can Believe Jesus and Still Refuse to Change
picks.summary: Tolstoy's spiritual awakening forced him to confront the difference between admiring Christ's teachings and actually living them. His study of the Sermon on the Mount challenged his desires, values, and response to evil, teaching him that following Jesus requires intentional obedience, self-denial, forgiveness, and a willingness to overcome evil with good. What might Christ be asking you to surrender and change today?   Join the mission. Be part of the impact — support here: 365 Christian Men Link
picks.reason: Reflects on Tolstoy's spiritual awakening and the challenge of living Christ's teachings.

picks.reason: Explores the meaning of the cross and Jesus' love in his crucifixion.

picks.title: Ishmael Redeemed: Called to the Kingdom
picks.summary:
In 1985, when Kamal Saleem arrived in the United States, he intended to conquer the West in the name of radical Islam. What Kamal didn't intend was that a tragic accident and a divine encounter with Christian medical professionals would permanently alter the course of his life. "The love and sacrificial giving of these men," says Kamal, caused him "to cry out to the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, acknowledging his need for the Savior".

Kamal Saleem, founder of Koome Ministries, talks about his belief in "the One True and Living God," Jesus, and introduces his book, Ishmael Redeemed: Called
picks.reason: Testimony of conversion from radical Islam to Christianity through divine encounter.

picks.title: 478 - Christian Roy - Technological Madness: The Logic of Domination
picks.summary: Christian Roy and I discuss Jacques Ellul’s theology of technique (technology) and the way modern systems turn power, efficiency, and mediation into ends in themselves. AI brings this crisis into focus, especially in our speech and relationships, but the deeper question is whether technology still serves a meaningful purpose —or whether we have begun to serve it. We also explore the Christian idea of non-power as a way beyond the logic of domination.YouTube version: https://youtu.be/HH_vCnVDTdoChristian’s book: Theology and Technique: https://www.amazon.ca/Theology-Technique-Jacques-Ellul/dp/1
picks.reason: A Christian critique of technology and power with theological insights.

picks.title: Why My Traumatic Memories Matter (Healing, Deliverance and Justice)
picks.summary: Why Memories Matter: Trauma, Forgiveness, and Testimony in the Courts of HeavenMemories are important, even if they contain details of traumatic events. Dan Duval argues that traumatic memories matter because avoiding them through dissociation and misusing “forgetting those things which are behind” can preserve demonic “legal access” and ongoing torment. In this podcast, you will learn why.He describes how prayer coaching engages dissociated parts, or “soul fragments,” in redemptive encounters with Jesus to recover memories, bring healing and deliverance, and reduce symptoms such as nightmares
picks.reason: Discusses trauma, forgiveness, and spiritual healing from a Christian perspective.
